info.name: Glimpse
info.summary: Search photos and videos by what is in them, using Immich
info.description:
A photo app for Nextcloud that understands your pictures. Describe what you are looking for – "woman on the beach", "dog in the snow", "birthday cake" – or pick a person. The image understanding (CLIP), face recognition, memories and duplicate detection come from a self-hosted [Immich](https://immich.app) that indexes your Nextcloud files read-only.
- **Search by content and people**, in the app and in Nextcloud's own search bar (also in the mobile apps); "Tara beach" finds Tara's beach pictures. "More like this" for any picture. - **Timeline, map, folders, "on this day", duplicates** – like a gallery app, with all of it searchable. - **Sort in bulk:** select many (long-press on touch), move or copy into folders with undo, tag, favorite, add to an album, download as ZIP, delete. - **People:** name, merge, hide, birthdays, favorites; assign single faces; "Label people" naming in a row. Faces are cut only from pictures the viewer may open. - **Private area:** folders, people and single pictures that only show after unlocking with your password – never in the global search. - **Nextcloud permissions decide:** one shared index, but every user only ever sees files they can open in Nextcloud – their own and those shared with them. - **Keeps Immich clean:** exclude file types and folders, take tiny images out for good. - In the Files app: a "Similar pictures" action and a sidebar tab with the people in a picture. A dashboard widget shows today's memories.
info.author: Florian Schneider
